changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionStatusLog_backup') BEGIN drop table dbo.FusionStatusLog_backup; END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionStatusLog_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FusionStatusLog_backup]( [ID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [FusionID] [int] NOT NULL, [DateStarted] [datetime] NOT NULL, [DateCompleted] [datetime] NULL, [MachineQueuedOn] [varchar](250) NULL, [Success] [bit] NOT NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [FullRefresh] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_FusionStatusLog_FullRefresh] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FusionStatusLog] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
